name: Sample Size
subtitle: The outside edit. Your taste, discovered.
localizedDescription: Black/silver clothing discovery and review workspace. Fresh official-store products, personal and brand taste lanes, saved collections, focused design reviews, multi-file references and casting profiles. Quarter-point ratings, Keep/Rework/Later/Scrap, weighted assessments, threaded notes and decision history. In-app arrival inbox; no background push or cloud sync. Feedback and added files stay on your device; JSON exports contain file identities, not attachment bytes. Unsigned: sign and install with your own Feather certificate. Requires iOS16.4 or later.
